about: Golden vectors of the executor model: what is derived from an executor entry and the machine, recorded from the Node functions that derive it today. A vector is { name, fact, entry?, runner?, machine?, args?, expect }. fact names the derivation; entry is one executor entry and runner the effective runner config the fact reads; machine describes the machine facts it reads (pathCommands: the only programs on PATH, registry: the confinement backend registry as absent/a document/raw text, home, accountState: the lease state file, files: relative path to text under the repository root, git: a repository with one commit); args are the remaining arguments; expect is the answer, a refusal being { error: { name, code?, message } }. A vector marked knownDefect records today's output of behaviour that looks wrong and is reported, not fixed. The doc is docs/platform/runner/contracts/executor-model.md.
